# Bundled libraries

Local copies so Aspirin Lab runs without internet when served over http (see `Start Aspirin Lab.command`).

| Folder | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `three/` | three.js 0.170.0 (npm `three`): core build plus the add-ons the page imports | MIT, see `three/LICENSE` |
| `mediapipe/` | MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.14 (npm `@mediapipe/tasks-vision`) | Apache-2.0 |
| `models/hand_landmarker.task` | MediaPipe Hand Landmarker, float16 v1 (storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models) | Apache-2.0 |
